data.narrative:
General Biological is a Series A biotech company founded by Abhi Godavarthi and David Sozanski that has raised $6.6M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 3 public Biotech & Health companies (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, and Recursion Pharmaceuticals.

Only one valuation method proved applicable given data constraints. Stage-progression analysis uses the $6.6M total raised as a proxy base value and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A to subsequent-stage progression, yielding a $13.2M implied valuation. Peer-median triangulation was not feasible; while 7 same-sector peers exist, none of the narrow filters (same-stage, adjacent-stage, similar-tier) produced the minimum 3 datapoints needed for reliable median pricing. Public-comp anchoring could not be executed because General Biological's revenue is not disclosed, precluding application of the 6.6x price-to-sales median observed across the 3 public comparables.

The single-method analysis supports a range of $11M to $15M, with a median of $13M. This range reflects applied step-up assumptions rather than triangulated consensus. Key uncertainties include the appropriate multiplier for General Biological's specific stage and therapeutic focus, and the absence of direct peer valuation data. Revenue disclosures or additional private-company comps at identical funding stage would materially improve precision.
